import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load_inline

# Define custom CUDA kernel for matrix multiplication (GEMM) using tiled approach.
# We implement a simple optimized matmul via element-wise accumulation in a single kernel.
matmul_source = """
#include <torch/extension.h>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>

__global__ void gemm_kernel(const float* A, const float* B, float* C, int M, int K, int N) {
    // Each thread computes one element of the output matrix C[i][j]
    // We use a 2D grid: blockIdx.x corresponds to i (row), blockIdx.y corresponds to j (col)
    // But for simplicity we launch enough blocks to cover all rows and columns.
    // Instead, we implement a naive but parallelized matmul where each thread handles one output element.
    int row = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
    int col = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;

    if (row < M && col < N) {
        float sum = 0.0f;
        for (int k = 0; k < K; ++k) {
            sum += A[row * K + k] * B[k * N + col];
        }
        C[row * N + col] = sum;
    }
}

torch::Tensor matmul_cuda(torch::Tensor A, torch::Tensor B) {
    auto M = A.size(0);
    auto K = A.size(1);
    auto N = B.size(1);

    // Allocate output tensor on the same device
    auto C = torch::zeros_like(A); // shape (M, N)

    const int block_size = 256;
    const int num_blocks_x = (N + block_size - 1) / block_size; // columns blocks
    const int num_blocks_y = (M + block_size - 1) / block_size; // rows blocks

    gemm_kernel<<<num_blocks_y, block_size, num_blocks_x>>>(
        A.data_ptr<float>(),
        B.data_ptr<float>(),
        C.data_ptr<float>(),
        M,
        K,
        N
    );

    return C;
}
"""

matmul_cpp_source = (
    "torch::Tensor matmul_cuda(torch::Tensor A, torch::Tensor B);"
)

# Compile the inline CUDA code for matrix multiplication
matmul = load_inline(
    name="matmul",
    cpp_sources=matmul_cpp_source,
    cuda_sources=matmul_source,
    functions=["matmul_cuda"],
    verbose=True,
    extra_cflags=[],
    extra_ldflags=[]
)

class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.matmul = matmul

    def forward(self, A: torch.Tensor, B: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        return self.matmul.matmul_cuda(A, B)
